title: Gayest Cities in South Florida
igCaption:
The gayest cities in South Florida, by the 2020 Census 🏳️‍🌈 Ranked by same-sex couples per 1,000 households. Did yours make it?

Sources: Williams Institute (UCLA School of Law), 2020 U.S. Census

#SouthFlorida #WiltonManors #FortLauderdale #Pride

scenes.text: These are the gayest cities in South Florida. Ranked by same-sex couples per household, from the 2020 Census.
Number five is Fort Lauderdale. About forty two of every thousand households are same-sex couples. And with about thirty five hundred couples, it has more than any other city on this list.
scenes.caption: #5 Fort Lauderdale: 41.8 of every 1,000 households are same-sex couples. 3,527 couples, the most on this list.

scenes.text: Number four, Miami Shores. Almost fifty two of every thousand households, from one hundred eighty nine couples.
scenes.caption: #4 Miami Shores: 51.7 per 1,000 households, from 189 couples.

scenes.text: Number three is tiny El Portal, right next door. Only fifty four couples, but that is seventy of every thousand households.
scenes.caption: #3 El Portal: just 54 couples, but 70 per 1,000 households.

scenes.text: Number two, Oakland Park. About seventy four of every thousand households. That ranks seventh in the entire country.
scenes.caption: #2 Oakland Park: 73.7 per 1,000 households. #7 in the whole U.S.

scenes.text: And number one is Wilton Manors. Two hundred thirteen of every thousand households are same-sex couples. That is the highest share of any city in the United States.
scenes.caption: #1 Wilton Manors: 213 of every 1,000 households are same-sex couples. #1 in the entire U.S.

scenes.text: Did your city make the list? Tag a friend who lives in one. And if you keep seeing the same faces out on Wilton Drive, NEAR is how you finally get their names.
